subject: Novata: platform demo coordination across security & eng teams
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@novata.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Novata IT <it-security@novata.com>, Elaine Choi <elaine.choi@novata.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Feb 2027 14:03:00 +0000
Subject: Demo request — Novata platform evaluation

Hi Jasmine,

We signed up for a trial yesterday and I wanted to schedule a walkthrough for our security and platform teams. We're evaluating inference platforms for a new product and want to make sure we cover SSO, data residency, and audit logs in the demo.

Attendees likely: myself (product), Elaine Choi (data security), and our IT security alias (it-security@novata.com). Prefer a session in the morning London time (09:00–11:00 GMT) two weeks out, if possible. Also fine with a late afternoon PST slot if that's easier for your team.

Thanks — happy to share our internal questionnaire ahead of time.

Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
Product Lead, Novata

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@novata.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, ava_chen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 1 Feb 2027 15:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo request — Novata platform evaluation

Hi Sanjay — great to meet you (virtually)!

Thanks for signing up and flagging the security scope — we should have the right folks on the call. Quick notes:
- Marissa (AE) will run the product walkthrough and discuss fit.
- Markus (SE) will cover integrations, SSO, and audit logs.
- Ava (solutions coordinator) will help finalize timing and send invites.

I pulled a couple of options below that work for our AE/SE mix; please pick what matches your team:
1) Tuesday, 16 Feb — 09:30 GMT / 01:30 PST
2) Wednesday, 17 Feb — 10:00 GMT / 02:00 PST
3) Friday, 19 Feb — 14:00 GMT / 06:00 PST (if you need later in the day)

If none of those work, tell me a few windows and we'll align. I'll attach a short demo agenda and a one-page SSO checklist so Elaine's team has context.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
SDR, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Novata-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@novata.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Novata IT <it-security@novata.com>, Elaine Choi <elaine.choi@novata.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 09:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Demo request — Novata platform evaluation

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the options.

We'd like to aim for option 2 (Wed, 17 Feb — 10:00 GMT). A couple of asks from IT/security before we lock:
- Can you confirm whether Demo includes a short segment on how Redwood handles KV cache and data retention (we have specific retention policies)?
- Our security team will want the SOC2/ISO attestation docs in advance if possible.

I'll plan to join with Elaine (security) and we'll loop in our infra lead if needed. Could you send a calendar invite with access details and SSO notes?

Best,
Sanjay

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@novata.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, ava_chen@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo request — Novata platform evaluation

Hi Sanjay — perfect, locking Wed 17 Feb 10:00 GMT.

Quick answers:
- Yes — Markus will demo KV cache behavior and walk through retention controls; we'll highlight what is configurable on Dedicated vs Hosted.
- I'll attach a link to our security pack (SOC 2 report + architecture diagram) — markus will also share a short checklist for SSO requirements.

Provisional agenda attached; Ava will drop the calendar invite once you confirm the final attendee list.

[Attachment: Novata-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@novata.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo request — Novata platform evaluation

Hi Sanjay — Marissa here (AE). Thanks for confirming 17 Feb. I will lead the demo. A few logistical notes:

- Confirmed time: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 — 10:00 GMT (that is Tue 16 Feb 02:00 PT? Actually convert: 10:00 GMT = 02:00 PT — sorry, my timezone math; we ran conversion the other way. For clarity: 10:00 GMT = 02:00 PST / 05:00 EST. If you prefer a later PST-friendly slot we can move to the 14:00 GMT option.)

(Editors note: we caught a timezone mismatch here. Ava will ensure invite shows both GMT and the right PST conversion.)

- Markus will cover SSO and retention. Could you share your SSO provider (e.g., Okta, Azure AD)? Also if you have a short list of IP allowlist ranges that matter for test environments, send those along.

- I'll attach a calendar invite (.ics) that Ava can finalize with the exact timezone mapping.

Looking forward to it — we'll keep it to 45 minutes with a 15-minute deep-dive for security questions.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-provisional-ics.ics (iCal, 2KB)]

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@novata.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Novata IT <it-security@novata.com>, Elaine Choi <elaine.choi@novata.com>, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Feb 2027 18:27:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Demo request — Novata platform evaluation

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the heads up on timing. My apologies, typo on our side: we actually meant 10:00 GMT is fine and we'll make sure a Novata infra engineer can join from 10:00–11:00 GMT. Our SSO provider is Okta — Elaine will send the specific config notes and a short internal questionnaire to your team by Monday.

Please include the Novata procurement alias (procurement@novata.com) on the invite as well so they can track approvals. Also happy to review SOC2/ISO docs ahead of time — can you share via a secure link?

See you on the 17th.

Sanjay
